integrity: A self-contained derivation from named classical inputs, a uniform tail inequality and finite exact checks; no independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Convergence is in distribution, not almost surely or in all moments. Uses the classical Hardy–Ramanujan and Erdős–Lehner theorems. Does not settle fixed-length mean monotonicity; broad partition-limit theorems may implicitly contain related statements.
title: A logarithmic limit law for integrals of normalized partition polynomials
